items.title: Tom Cruise keeps posting through Digger's flop
items.summary: Alejandro G. Iñárritu's Digger, with Tom Cruise in a fat suit, opened to about $8M against a $160-180M budget and was projected to lose $250M, one of the biggest bombs ever. Cruise said he doesn't make movies for "opening weekend" and kept posting: on Oct 9 he shared a speech scene from the film (162K likes) and stills captioned "Level 4." (61K). "Digger is flopping at the box office, going triple platinum on letterboxd, and Tom Cruise is tweeting through it" summed up the week, alongside jokes that the marketing only ever said "Tom Cruise is Digger."
items.author: @TomCruise
